metadata.description: House of Vibe Claude Code tools for builders.

plugins.name: token-eater
plugins.description: Spend expiring AI credits on isolated, verified code cleanup that opens a draft pull request and never merges.

plugins.name: pro-gate
plugins.description: Run a final pull request review using the Pro model selected by your ChatGPT account, with guided runtime setup and no automatic merge.

plugins.name: skill-tuner
plugins.description: Tell whether a change to an agent-consumed document actually worked. /skill-tuner:tune probes a SKILL.md, AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md, fixes what three independent skeptics confirm, and proves the description still routes. Paired comparison with a confidence interval, content-hashed provenance with drift detection, and it reads skill-creator benchmark output.
